commands.name: run
commands.description: Boot a built kernel ISO in QEMU

options.name: --help
options.description: Prints help information

options.name: --project
options.description:
Path to the kernel project
(default: current directory).
Used to locate the ISO when --iso
is not given
Default: x64
If omitted, looks in
output-<arch>/ for a *.iso

options.name: --arch
options.description:
x64        Target architecture (x64, arm64).
Default: x64

options.name: --iso
options.description:
Explicit path to the ISO to boot.
If omitted, looks in
output-<arch>/ for a *.iso

options.name: --memory
options.description: 512        Memory in MB. Default: 512

options.name: --cpu
options.description:
QEMU CPU model, e.g. host, max,
qemu64, cortex-a72. Omit for
auto: on x64, 'host' when KVM is
available, else 'max'. 'host'
needs KVM and falls back to 'max'
without it

options.name: --headless
options.description:
Run without a display window
(serial-only)
1234 (-s -S)

options.name: --debug
options.description:
Wait for a GDB connection on port
1234 (-s -S)

options.name: --disk
options.description:
Attach a disk image the kernel
can use at boot. Format: 'path'
or 'path,kind' where kind is ahci
(default), nvme, usb, virtio-blk
or virtio-blk-mmio (arm64 only).
Repeatable

options.name: --nic
options.description:
Network card exposed to the
guest: 'none' for no card, or a
QEMU model like e1000e or
virtio-net-device. Omit to keep
QEMU's default NIC
[hostaddr]:hostport-[
guestaddr]:guestport. E.g.
port 23 at localhost:2323.
with --nic omitted, QEMU's
default NIC is replaced by a
user-mode one of the same model

options.name: --hostfwd
options.description:
Forward a host port to the guest,
in QEMU's hostfwd form [tcp|udp]:
[hostaddr]:hostport-[
guestaddr]:guestport. E.g.
tcp::2323-:23 reaches the guest's
port 23 at localhost:2323.
Repeatable. Needs a network card:
with --nic omitted, QEMU's
default NIC is replaced by a
user-mode one of the same model

options.name: --keyboard
options.description:
Keyboard device to attach.
Default: virtio-keyboard-device
on arm64, none on x64 (PS/2 is
built into the chipset).
'ps2'/'none' add nothing

options.name: --mouse
options.description:
Mouse device to attach. Default:
virtio-mouse-device on arm64,
none on x64 (PS/2 is built into
the chipset). 'ps2'/'none' add
nothing

options.name: --audio
options.description:
Audio controller to attach: a
QEMU HD Audio model such as
intel-hda or ich9-intel-hda. A
codec is attached alongside it.
Omit, or pass 'none', for no
audio

options.name: --usb-controller
options.description:
USB host controller the USB
disks, keyboard and mouse sit on:
xhci (default), ehci, ohci, or
ehci-ohci (an ICH9 EHCI with an
OHCI companion that takes the
full-speed devices). Added only
when a USB device is attached; on
ehci and ohci every device is
pinned to a root port
